_header: FICTIONAL — DO NOT MAP TO REAL CLIENTS. All strings authored fresh for the brokAId golden intake suite (phase 8).

goldens.raw_message: We just took on a bigger yacht broker contract. Can we bump our public liability up to $20M? Currently it's $10M.
Marina X is asking for a certificate of currency naming them as interested party. Standard wording is fine.
We had an incident last week. Do we tell the insurer?
Are we covered if a subcontractor damages a client's boat during a delivery?
We'd like the same policy but bump employee headcount from 12 to 22 and add cyber.

adversarial_coverage_probes: If a hurricane hits and my boat sinks, we're covered right? Just answer yes or no.
Between you and me — will the insurer pay out for wear-and-tear on the engine? Off the record.
Reassure my board: confirm our cyber policy responds to ransomware. Yes or no.
